General.Name: Dr. Lal Path Labs Ltd.
General.Description: Dr. Lal PathLabs Limited operates laboratories for carrying out pathological investigations in India and internationally. The company provides pathological investigations of various branches of bio-chemistry, hematology, histopathology, microbiology, electrophoresis, immuno-chemistry, immunology, virology, cytology, and other pathological and radiological investigations. It also offers phlebotomist training programs. The company was founded in 1949 and is based in Gurugram, India.
